declared_canon_note: AOB = printed Abbreviations of Books (KoshaSHRI official PDF, re-OCR ground truth 14-10-2026). 1,418 pass-1 machine rows + the Visnupurana row recovered = 1,419 ENTRY-level rows, dictionary-wide, not letter-a. H6923 audit (17-10-2026): 1,419 has no committed parser behind it (the committed re-parse gives 1,517 raw entries, the printed OCR 1,476 entry-like lines, the print census 1,464), so the denominator is the band 1,419-1,517 and metric 2 spans 7.78-8.32 %. RULING (MG 17-10-2026, applied in the H6933 pass): the quoted denominator is the CENTRAL estimate 1,476 entry rows -> 118/1,476 = 7.99 % (8.0 %, one in twelve and a half); the pass-1 point 8.32 % survives as the band's upper bound. The published artifact data/pd/pd_aob_declared_works.tsv carries 1,112 works / 1,118 edition rows and is a clean-subset FLOOR, NOT the canon: the pass-2 clean filter dropped 556 OCR-merged 'Siglum Title' entry lines plus the garbled-start rows, so 118/1,118 = 10.55 % (10.6 % in the paper) overstates coverage and must never be quoted as the declared canon.
